verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows testing/simulation tools (pytest/Vitest, LLM-driven simulations) but no built-in production analytics dashboard for success rates, durations, outcomes, or sentiment. A community report explicitly confirms this gap — users running LiveKit voice agents said they had 'no way to measure TTFT, latency across STT→LLM→TTS, or even cost per call' and found debugging painful, indicating no such dashboard exists out of the box.
